apps.description: The app engine beside the cluster: chloedb-apps in a Deployment of one, which the command center shows under Apps. It keeps the apps it builds as rows of the cluster, calls the model with secretEnv's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and needs tokenSecret: its studio, at publicUrl, signs admins in with a link the command center hands out.

env.description: The engine's own settings (STRATA_APPS_MODEL, ...); secrets go in secretEnv.

nodePort.description: A NodePort Service's port (Kubernetes picks one when left out).

paused.description: No engine pod for now (the apps stay).

publicUrl.description: Where browsers reach the studio, which Open the studio links to: a NodePort, a LoadBalancer or an Ingress of your own in front of the Service.

publish.description: Open the apps their owners publish to everyone, at <name>.<domain>, with certificates from Let's Encrypt, behind a load balancer of their own (<cluster>-apps-public).

domain.description: apps.example.com, with a DNS record *.apps.example.com pointing at the load balancer; or sslip: its address as a name of sslip.io, with no record.

email.description: Who Let's Encrypt writes to about the certificates.

spendCapUsd.description: What the model may cost, in US dollars, before every call is refused until it is raised (default 25; 0: no limit).

storage.description: Its volume (files, map tiles, the spend count): made once, kept when spec.apps goes, deleted with the cluster.

tables.description: The tables the app's own key may touch, as table=scope (a name, a prefix and *, or *; read, write or admin). Default: sa_*=admin, app_*=admin.

autoscale.description: Rules that change the copies, shards or volumes from how busy and full the servers are.

cooldownMinutes.description: Minutes after a change before the next (default 20).

freeze.description: Weekly windows, in UTC, in which nothing changes.

allowGrow.description: Copies may still be added in it (default true).

from.description: A day and a time, like Fri 16:00.

to.description: A day and a time, like Mon 08:00.

grow.description: Add copies when the busiest shard's copies are busy.

busyAbove.description: The share of their cores the copies use (default 0.7).

max.description: Copies of each shard at most (default 5).

mode.description: off: nothing (the rules can be replayed); suggest: a change waits in status.autoscale for a person; on: the operator makes it (default off).

shrink.description: Remove a copy when every shard's copies are idle.

busyBelow.description: The share of their cores the busiest shard's copies use (default 0.35).

min.description: Copies of each shard at least (default 2).

action.description: grow: every volume by half; addShard: one more shard (default grow).

maxShards.description: addShard: the shards the cluster grows to at most (default 16).

maxSize.description: grow: the size a volume grows to at most, as 500Gi (default 1Ti).

chloectx.description: ChloeCtx beside the cluster: a chloectx app Deployment of one, which the command center shows under Apps (Context: memory spaces agents write to and ask for context; Seen before: firing alerts beside the past incidents they look like). Its spaces are tables of the cluster.

embedder.description: static (default: its 125 MB model is downloaded from Hugging Face at each start) or hash:<dim> (no model, vectors from hashed words).

paused.description: No ChloeCtx pod for now (the spaces stay).

tables.description: The tables the app's own key may touch, as table=scope (a name, a prefix and *, or *; read, write or admin). Default: ctx_*=admin, chloectx_memory=read.

clusterTokenSecret.description: A Secret whose key token is the cluster's token (--cluster-token), which the servers and coordinators send each other and clients never hold. Needs tokenSecret.

coordinatorStorage.description: A volume for each coordinator, which keeps its history across restarts and rollouts: its log store (events, alerts, query statistics, table growth), its audit log and its alert rules. With it the coordinators run as a StatefulSet, each with a volume; without it (the default) as a Deployment that keeps all of that in memory only. Run 2 coordinators or more with it: a StatefulSet restarts one before it starts its next.

size.description: Each coordinator's volume (default 2Gi; its log store takes up to 1 GiB, --log-store-mb).

crawler.description: A crawler beside the cluster: a chloedb-crawl Deployment of one, which the command center shows under Apps; it crawls sites into tables and adds shards as they fill.

grow.description: Add a shard when a crawl's table fills one (default true).

splitRows.description: Rows of a crawl's table on a shard past which the cluster gets one more shard (0: never; default 100000).

tables.description: The tables the app's own key may touch, as table=scope (a name, a prefix and *, or *; read, write or admin). Default: *=admin.

demo.description: Instead of a schema: this many demo products, split over the shards the cluster starts with.

environment.description: What the cluster is to its people (production, staging): the command center shows it on every page.

failoverAfterMs.description: --failover-after-ms of every server (default 3000; 0: failover by hand).

follow.description: Following another cluster: a chloedb-server follow Deployment of one copies the source, then applies its feed; the cluster refuses its clients' writes meanwhile.

askedMs.description: When following was asked for (ms since the epoch): a copy is made once, and a stop or promotion after it is final for this spec.

caSecret.description: A Secret whose key ca.crt is the CA certificate (PEM) of the source's TLS certificate, for a self-signed one.

keySecret.description: A Secret whose key key is a key of the source of the feed scope.

name.description: The name this cluster knows the source by.

paused.description: No follow process for now; the cluster still refuses its clients' writes.

resources.description: Resources of the follow process's container.

source.description: The source cluster's URL (its coordinators), as https://east.example:7700.

start.description: follow (default): from where the cluster is, a copy the first time; copy: a copy afresh (an old source rejoining); reverse: back from the source's promotion from this cluster, without a copy.

image.description: The chloedb-server image of every server (default chloedb-server:dev).

netops.description: Network operations beside the cluster: a chloedb-netops Deployment of one, which the command center shows under Apps; its network, telemetry, incidents and agents' runs are rows of the cluster's tables netops_*.

paused.description: No pod for now (the tables stay; nothing is written to them).

tables.description: The tables the app's own key may touch, as table=scope (a name, a prefix and *, or *; read, write or admin). Default: netops_*=admin.

replicas.description: Copies of each shard: a primary and its replicas (default 3).

rollout.description: How changes are made: paused, or held by gates on the cluster's live numbers.

extraCopies.description: A shard of fewer than three copies takes more, with the new settings, before its copies restart, and lets them go after: most of its copies serve while each restarts (default true).

gates.description: Limits on live numbers: one over its limit for holdAfterSeconds holds the change until it is resumed.

errorRatio.description: The share of searches that fail.

p99Ms.description: The search p99 the coordinator's clients see, in ms.

replicaBehind.description: The transactions a replica is behind its primary.

holdAfterSeconds.description: How long a gate is over its limit before it holds the change, or a check fails while a version is verified (default 30).

onFailure.description: What a version that fails a check gets: rollback (default) restores the last version that ran everywhere; hold holds it until it is resumed.

paused.description: While true the operator takes no step toward the spec (a copy that lost its data still joins again).

progressDeadlineSeconds.description: How long one step of a rollout (the image tried on every node, the coordinators restarting, a copy restarting and catching up, the verification) may take before the version fails (default 600).

soakSeconds.description: How long a copy restarted with new settings serves before the next restarts (default 0).

verifySeconds.description: How long the cluster must stay healthy once every server runs a version that restarted them, before it counts as rolled out (default 60; 0: not verified).

schema.description: The first table's schema, as chloedb-server --schema takes it. Without it and without demo, the cluster starts with no tables.

secretEnv.description: Environment variables of every server and coordinator taken from Secrets: the keys of models behind an API (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for the agents, LLM fields and reranking; OPENAI_API_KEY, COHERE_API_KEY, ... for hosted embeddings). Changing it restarts the copies one at a time.

key.description: The Secret's key that holds the value (default key).

secret.description: The Secret, in the cluster's namespace.

shards.description: Shards, each holding a part of the 4,096 slots (default 1).

sheets.description: Spreadsheets beside the cluster: a chloedb-sheets Deployment of one, which the command center shows under Apps; its workbooks are rows of two tables of the cluster, and the cluster's tables open in it as sheets.

paused.description: No spreadsheets pod for now (the workbooks stay).

tables.description: The tables the app's own key may touch, as table=scope (a name, a prefix and *, or *; read, write or admin). Default: sheets_*=admin, *=read.

tokenSecret.description: A Secret whose key token every server and coordinator requires; with clusterTokenSecret, the coordinators only (the admin token).

upgrade.description: Following an image tag for new versions of ChloeDB: a new image is suggested (suggest) or rolled out (on), by its digest.

checkMinutes.description: Minutes between two looks at the registry (default 10).

mode.description: off (default): no registry is asked; suggest: a new image waits in status.upgrade for a person; on: the operator rolls it out once the cluster is ready, and the app engine (spec.apps, at a tag) runs its tag's newest image too.

track.description: The image tag to follow (default: the image's repository at its tag, or at latest).

status.description: What the operator found and does.
